brief.zh: 先按 a1 加一次噪，再对结果按 a2 加一次噪。输出加了两次以后的图。
brief.en: Add noise once with a1, then add noise to the result again with a2. Output the picture after both.

after.zh: 展开以后，x₀ 前面的系数是 √(a1·a2)，两份噪声合起来正好是方差 1 − a1·a2 的一份噪声：两次加噪，和按 ᾱ = a1·a2 一次加噪是同一回事。所以扩散的每一步都能一步跳到。
after.en: Expand it and the coefficient of x₀ is √(a1·a2), while the two noises together are exactly one noise of variance 1 − a1·a2: adding noise twice is the same thing as adding it once with ᾱ = a1·a2. That is why any step of diffusion can be reached in one jump.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="own-8-7"></part-ref>把 x₀ 一步加噪到第 t 步：输出 √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε。
t.en: The <part-ref to="own-8-7"></part-ref> in the tray takes x₀ straight to step t: it outputs √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：加两次噪，输出加完两次的图。
t.en: Your task in this level: add noise twice and output the picture after both.
